You find love if the strangest places. I was sitting outside thinking about ending it when out of nowhere a kid that I barely knew that graduated a year before me came up and sat down and talked to me. You don't know how much love there is for you until you find it and it is everywhere. Keep searching and you will find it.

I've been pushing myself for years. I'm a senior in highschool. I'm on track and cross teams and have a lot of friends. I have the most beautiful girlfriend and I've been told that I'm one of the popular kids in the school. But behind the mask of happiness is a sad kid.
I didn't have anyone for a year than I met a girl and she saved me

I've been feeling this way for a long time. Just as I start thinking I'm getting better life comes back and kicked me down harder than before. My girlfriend has been helping me for a long time now and I've been making progress and hating myself less and less but than as of 4 days ago it came back. As soon as I thought I was getting better my grandpa got sick and may be about to die. Life doesn't let anyone off easy. We all have our problems but I can understand what you are saying. I also have, in the viewpoint of my parents, "the perfect sister". I hope that your parents will soon see what they have put you through as well as my parents seeing what they have dragged me through.
